howto: Your car drives up a 3-lane neon road.
Tap the left or right half of the road (or press Left / Right) to change lane.
Red barriers and orange cones end the run: be in another lane when they reach you.
Gold coins are worth 5 points. Survive 60 seconds to escape.
tips: Only one lane changes per tap, so plan two moves ahead when you are on the edge.
Traffic speeds up as your score rises, so coins make the road harder.
The middle lane lets you dodge either way.
Easy spaces the traffic out; Hard packs it in and speeds it up.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right arrows (or A / D) change lane; Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the left or right half of the road. Pause button top left.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title screen set traffic speed and spacing. Traffic also speeds up as your score climbs.

cheats.effect: Drive straight through barriers and cones
Traffic and coins move at 60% speed

features.one-tap-start: Tap, Space or an arrow key on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the CRASHED! or ESCAPED! card
features.best-score-badge: BEST under the score at the top
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated swipe; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: CRASHED! / ESCAPED! card with coins, score and best
